    Literal middle-support Cartan data #

    This file assembles all algebraic and coordinate fields of the manuscript's middle-support Cartan package from the literal complementary-vertex quotient. The only remaining input is the root/Coxeter assertion for the two endpoints of each supported Auslander--Reiten sequence.
